_comment: Directories used by the entry points (entry_points/). The tools and harness scripts keep fixed paths inside the repository: tools/rebuild_worlds.py (replays/, data/worlds/), harness/tape_worlds.py (replays/worlds/), tools/fetch_league_bots.py (agents/, runs/league_bots_cache/). Relative paths are resolved against the repository root. The training code (rl/appo.py) changes into the repository root, and configs/league_d7.json refers to tape-world pools as data/pools/*.json, so keep DATA_DIR = data unless you also rewrite the league (entry_points/train_appo.py does this automatically when DATA_DIR differs).
